hypothesis: With the prompt, inputs, parser, and thresholds unchanged, server-side Qwen3-8B will preserve at least 57 of 60 required fragments while forwarding at most 42 of 420 extra fragments.
plain_language_hypothesis: Can a larger server Qwen stop the junk without throwing away the seven useful safety rules?
only_intended_change: Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B becomes Qwen/Qwen3-8B. Everything else is copied from Gate 15B.

prompt.system: You are a relevance gate. Judge only whether one source fragment directly helps answer one user question.

decision_rule: USEFUL moves forward. NOT_USEFUL and unparseable outputs do not move forward. Run once without prompt or threshold tuning.
manual_audit_plan: Read every lost required fragment and every passed extra fragment after the locked run. Preserve the mechanical score even if the frozen gold is later found ambiguous.
boundaries: These are the same already opened synthetic English pairs used by Gates 15A and 15B, so this is a paired comparative development test, not fresh held-out evidence.
This isolates model scale only. It does not test training, quantization, a phone, truth, privacy, or the full pipeline.
A successful 8B result would support optional server-side filtering, not replacing the phone preset or making private memory leave its owner device.
No later harness stage runs in Gate 15C.
